title: Report upstream: go-udx/dart-udx issues found during port
description: See PLAN.md 'Upstream issues found' (Go and Dart): frame numbering 0x0c-0x11; stale v2 interop server/test; udx.Dial dual-stack batching drop; RTO formula; collapsed RTO timer; ssthresh 65535; PENDING_WORK §5 stale; Dart PMTUD never ACKed; Dart ping vs Go; Dart anti-amp proves nothing; Dart STOP_SENDING 0x0c rejected.

title: Port UDX v3 to TypeScript + js-libp2p transport
description: See PLAN.md. Wire authority: go-udx; feature parity: dart-udx.

title: Phase 0: Scaffold workspaces, TS, vitest
description: npm workspaces packages/udx + packages/libp2p-udx, ESM, Node>=20, tsconfig, vitest, lint, CI script.
close_reason: Workspaces, TS build, vitest, eslint, ci script in place; npm run ci passes

title: Phase 1: Packet + frame codec with Go golden vectors
description: Header + all 17 frame types (Go numbering). tools/gen-vectors Go program; byte-exact checks. Port Dart frame_test/udx_test/cid_test.
close_reason: Codec for header + all 17 frames, version negotiation, stateless reset; byte-exact vs go-udx 47894a1 vectors incl. 2013 truncations and 2000 fuzz cases

title: Phase 2: Reliability engine (ACK tracker, packet manager, RTT, CUBIC, pacing)
description: Socket-free, injectable clock. Fresh-seq retransmit, no retry cap. One timer per connection. Port Go loss_detection/retransmit_recovery/ack_policy/congestion tests.
close_reason: ACK tracker, ACK scheduler, RTT/CUBIC, pacer, sent-packet manager, LossRecovery facade; Go unit tests ported; deterministic simulated-link transfers (clean/reorder/loss/mobile)

title: Phase 3: Connection, stream, multiplexer over node:dgram
description: CID routing, stream id resolution (dst then remoteId==src), flow control, half-close, reset, idle watchdog, async-iterable stream API.
close_reason: Connection, stream, multiplexer, flow control, idle timeout over node:dgram; memory network e2e suite; real-UDP tests; interop with go-udx both directions (1 KB to 4 MiB, 8 streams)

title: Phase 4: Dart parity features
description: Version negotiation, anti-amplification, connection flow control (verify vs Go before default-on), PMTUD (respect Go 1600B rx buffer), migration, stateless reset.
close_reason: Version negotiation, anti-amplification (PATH_CHALLENGE proof), path migration, PMTUD (PING+MTU_PROBE), Dart-semantics connection flow control, opt-in stateless reset; acked PINGs; parity tests + Go interop checks

title: Phase 5: UDX interop harness vs go-udx/dart-udx
description: bin/bulk-peer matching Dart bulk_peer CLI/stderr protocol so go-udx/interop tests can drive JS; JS tests spawning Go peers; later netem docker.

title: Phase 6: libp2p-udx transport
description: Multiaddr udx=0x0300 size 0; Transport/Listener; MultiaddrConnection over first UDX stream -> upgrader (Noise+Yamux); shared dial socket per family.

title: Phase 7: libp2p interop vs go-libp2p and dart-libp2p
description: go-peer --transport=udx, dart interop_echo_server/client: identify, echo, ping.
